notes.title: Meet the Developer: SameShadow Insights with GrandPaw Games!
notes.notes:
Dear Gamers,

Discover the inner workings of SameShadow: Fernando’s Journey with GrandPaw Games! In this exclusive interview, delve into key topics such as the unique blend of third-person shooter and hack-and-slash gameplay, the challenges faced as an indie game developer, and the inspiration behind the game's creation. Gain profound insights into the vision that propels GrandPaw Games forward.

Curious minds are invited to explore the full interview on [url=https://minimap.net/magazine/steam-next-fest-same-shadow-fernandos-journey-grandpawgames]Minimap[/url]. Uncover the passion, challenges, and inspirations that breathe life into SameShadow.

Best,
GrandPaw Games

notes.title: Fernando's Journey is Here!
notes.notes:
Dear Gamers,

I'm thrilled to announce that the demo for "SameShadow: Fernando's Journey" is now live! Dive into the action, explore the road ahead, and experience the beginning of an epic journey.

Play the demo and share your thoughts. Your feedback is invaluable as we shape the full adventure.

Enjoy the game, and thank you for being a part of this exciting chapter!

Best,
GrandPaw Games

notes.title: Skill tree and complimentary abilities Showcase!
notes.notes:
[u][b]It's now fully Integrated! [/b][/u]

[b]Skill tree (J) will now be available during gameplay.[/b] It will Not Pause your game so be careful when you stop to check them out. 
You'll be able to Awaken powers within you by holding "F" over a skill that's accessible, and spending the necessary "Awaken Points". 

[b]Awaken points will be given as you level up although some can be found through exploration.[/b] (Red Auras are Healing, Golden are Awaken Points)
You'll earn Experience as you defeat enemies. 

---The last two abilities that will be added this week will be Time Dominion and Vanish. 

[b]-Time Dominion:[/b] Slow down time around you at your will. Tare your enemies apart without them being able to put much resistance. This extreme exertion will drain half your Current Health, and exhaust 50% of your Max Energy + Your Base Energy. This can exceed your Exhaustion Max so be careful.

[b]-Vanish:[/b] At Close to Mid range leach a percentage of the targeted Enemy's current health and make them Vanish... somewhere. There is a chance they will Resist you. You'll need to reduce a Boss's Health by Half to be able to attempt this ability on them. 
Tougher enemies have a higher chance to resist just like with Tele Takedowns, but you can Awaken your Luck to not only increase your chances for success in these abilities, but to land Melee and Bullet Critical Damage as well. 


[b]Ability Slots[/b]

[i]You'll be able to equip 4 abilities at a time[/i], being able to switch back and forth between the 7 that require a slot. 
These abilities are: [i]Time Dominion, Particle Acceleration, Rage, Rapid Regeneration, Reduced Friction, Bullet Rush and Vanish. [/i] (Gameplay video/trailer has been updated to reflect the added abilities. Please check it out) 

You will not require an Ability slot for Knife Throw, Tele Jump or Sword Master but for the last option you will require your Sword. 

----

I hope you enjoy as this will be one of the biggest Demo updates in a while. There will still be patches based on feedback, but no further Updates have been planned. 
Thank you for Trying out SameShadow! 

[i][b]I am just one person making this happen, so I really appreciate your comments, feedback and taking the time to Wishlist. [/b][/i]

[i]Please follow the process on Tiktok, Twitter or Youtube. [/i]

notes.title: Particle Acceleration and Bullet Rush
notes.notes:
[b]Particle Acceleration and Bullet Rush[/b] have been added inside training grounds and will also be available to use in the last map in the demo. 
Currently, you can access them by pressing 2 (Particle Acceleration) and 6 (Bullet Rush). 

-[b]Particle Acceleration is a Short-Mid Range[/b] attack that blows a targeted enemy back dealing Ragdoll Damage and of course, ragdolling the enemies giving you some precious time. 
--The Range and Width of this attack can be updated to be able to better "catch" the enemy at close range. 
--Upgrading Ragdoll Damage Passive skills will not only increase the Damage dealt by this ability, but also anything else that deals Ragdoll Damage, such as Counters and Run Melee Attacks. 

-[b]Bullet Rush is a Mid-Long Range attack.[/b] This is the longest ranged Ability. Uses the remaining bullets you have by a count of 10, and hurls them at an aimed enemy using up your Energy per amount of bullets you have. This can deal a great deal of Damage all at once if you plenty of unused bullets. It can also completely exhaust you so be careful. 
--The Range and Damage of this skill can be updated. 
--Great choice for those focused on Melee build but would still want to have a long range option. 

--------------

The next two abilities that will be added to the Demo will be "Vanish" and "Time Dominion". 
Working on an option to have Skill tree available in the Demo.

notes.title: Aug 15, 2023 Update
notes.notes: Engine upgrade from UE5.0 to 5.2. Updated foliage to Nanite. Nvidia's DLSS integration for better performance. Three new skills now allowed in the Training Grounds and the Cathedral/Last Level. Overall lighting fixes in first level as well as some bug fixes. A "Rock Combat Music" option was added in the Audio Settings.
